The '''1928–29 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]'s''' [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|27th season]] in existence, and their [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time_table|first]] in the [[La Liga|Primera División]], the [[Spanish football league system|top flight]] of Spanish football. The club also played in the [[Campeonato Regional Centro]] (Central Regional Championship) and the [[Copa del Rey]].
